fix_subject: Do not dereference the maximum of an empty selection buffer when finalizing a dictionary segment
pr_title: Merge #26633: Do not dereference the maximum of an empty selection buffer when finalizing a dictionary segment

labels.summary: The dictionary compression finalize assertion dereferenced max_element of an empty selection buffer (for example, the child segment of a column of empty lists), which is undefined behaviour; the fix skips the check when the buffer is empty.
